info.name: BulkUploadResource
info.description:
Postman collection for POST /api/v1/assets/_bulkupload (#37166).

Stub created by /speckit-implement T003. Requests are added under T021, which sits behind the US1 TDD gates (T022 approval, T023 Red) - do not add them ahead of those.

Contract: specs/37166-bulk-file-upload/contracts/bulk-upload-api.md

item.name: Accepts a batch and answers 202 with a handle

request.description: The happy path. The response must arrive before the files exist - 202 means queued, not done - and must carry statusUrl as well as jobId so the client is not left assembling URLs by hand.

item.name: Refuses a batch with no files

request.description: An empty batch is not an empty success (spec FR-003).
Only DOTASSET and FILEASSET carry files; anything else reaches the creation path with no binary to place (spec FR-003).

item.name: Refuses both folderId and siteId together

request.description: Two targets is neither a merge nor a preference order - the caller has said two contradictory things and the server must not choose (ADR-0020).

item.name: Refuses a declared total over the ceiling with 413

request.description: The courtesy refusal (spec FR-013c.1): decided before the body is read, so an author is not made to upload gigabytes before being told no. 413 rather than 400 because a size problem has a different fix from a shape problem.

const apiUrl = `${serverURL}/api/v1/apitoken`; // Construct the full API URL
